level_1.description: A fixed high-angle camera overlooks a broad lawn beside a paved plaza and driveway meeting a background road, with a stop sign, sidewalks, landscaped islands, trees and a small gray gabled building on the right.

events.caption: A person in a light gray sleeveless top and dark shorts walks right across the paved plaza while pulling a dark wheeled suitcase.
A blue pickup enters from the lower left, drives diagonally toward the upper right and stops beside the person at the junction.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top and dark shorts pulls a suitcase from the curb toward the near-side front door of the stopped blue pickup.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top pulls open the near-side front door of the blue pickup.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top opens the smaller rear access door behind the blue pickup front door.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top lifts a dark suitcase from the pavement toward the open rear cabin of the blue pickup.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top repeatedly bends and reaches into the open rear cabin of the blue pickup before straightening.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top swings shut the smaller rear access door of the blue pickup.
A person in a light gray sleeveless top and dark shorts steps up through the open front doorway and lowers into the blue pickup cab.
A person inside the blue pickup pulls its near-side front door closed.
The blue pickup pulls away from the junction, turns right onto the background road and drives right out of view.
